summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) variant in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated on is_terminal and returning a bool; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch calling term.set_title with the title; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests added to test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (the last is Windows-only). Notes: on TERM=dumb, set_window_title returns True but Console.control drops the segment, following the existing show_cursor pattern. Title text is not sanitized, so embedded BEL or ESC can end the sequence early. Tests were not run; verification was by reading only.
